frequency_question: How often does the council approve major tax classifications and rate adjustments proposed by the dominant fiscal principals within the stipulated window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal agenda items proposed by the central Ministry of Finance regarding service sector GST clarifications or rate changes submitted to the council; excludes informal discussions without formal voting agendas.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 7 major service tax and classification items brought to formal vote by the central authority; all successfully approved.
known_gaps: Minor state-level pushbacks occasionally delay implementation dates, but do not block ultimate Council approval of central fiscal clarifications.
validity_reason: The voting dynamics and dominance of the central fiscal authority within the council remain structurally consistent over medium-term political cycles.
